class.name: PuertsStringNameCachePool
class.description: Initialize before passing the pool to an environment. It is not synchronized; cache capacity overflow clears all entries.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Selects a policy and clears entries. HASH_MAP uses capacity, FIXED_HASH_MAP uses 1024 entries, and NO_CACHE does not retain entries.

method.name: clear
method.description: Discards cached names without changing policy or capacity.

method.name: get_capacity
method.description: Returns the configured capacity; the fixed policy reports 1024.

constants.constant: Caches up to the configured capacity, allocating entries as needed.
Uses fixed storage for 1024 entries; ignores the capacity argument.
Converts each name to UTF-8 on every request without retaining cache entries.
